content: Invoice vs receipt (Invoice Simple guide): invoice = request for payment, sent BEFORE payment; contains amount due, itemized breakdown, due date, payment terms, unique invoice number, seller+buyer info. Receipt = proof payment received, issued AFTER payment; contains amount paid, payment method, transaction date, unique receipt number, seller info, signature. Quote/estimate = preliminary pricing proposal with expiration; converts to invoice when accepted. All three share the same core structure (seller/buyer/line items/totals) — one shared document engine is feasible; differences are purpose, fields shown, and lifecycle state.
